**Paper and version** (e.g. first-slab-positivity v1.0):

**Item** (checklist id, e.g. A1, B3, C1, D2; or a section/equation number):

**What I checked**

**How** (by hand / recomputation — give tool and precision / against which primary source):

**Result**
- [ ] Holds as stated
- [ ] Holds with a correction (describe below)
- [ ] Does not hold (open a "Possible error" issue as well, or describe here)
- [ ] Could not complete (say what blocked you)

**Details**

**Time spent** (optional):

**Credit** — may we name you in the status file? yes / no
